name: Phase Completion Summary
description: Generates a comprehensive summary when a phase completes
userPromptText:
Phase <%= it.events[0]?.data?.phaseId || 'unknown' %> has completed with status: <%= it.events[0]?.data?.success || 'unknown' %>

Duration: <%= it.events[0]?.data?.duration || 0 %>ms
Cost: $<%= it.events[0]?.data?.cost || 0 %>
Exit status: <%= JSON.stringify(it.events[0]?.data?.exitStatus) %>

Generate a comprehensive summary including:
1. What was accomplished
2. Key decisions made
3. Files created or modified
4. Any issues encountered
5. Recommendations for next phase
